value.rationale: This is a complete, natural all-size classification of exact term-level expressivity for the endpoint consistency connective employed in current four-valued and modal algebraic semantics. The normal form constructs any term operation, the exact closed formula measures its growth, and the threshold identifies the optimal number of Boolean atoms needed to distinguish all m-variable identities; this is not a parameter-renamed textbook deduction or an arbitrary isolated finite table. General discriminator interpolation is acknowledged as prior. The usefulness is for algebraic normal-form synthesis and bounded-variable identity comparison; no wider consequence or large-scale theory is claimed.
